concept.description: What the learner should notice and the representation you chose for it, derived from the user's description (or your best judgement where it is silent).

object.description: The real thing this participant is.

representation.description: How it looks and which kit binding shows its solver fields (body moved along its position, or an instrument: its moving part and the drive mapping from the field).

animation.description: How each changing field is animated on the stage.

palette.description: Colours readable in light and dark themes.

description.description: One or two sentences in the user's language describing the illustrated scene.

environment.description: Full-scene SVG document (the world behind everything, drawn for a ~16:9 frame, scaled to cover the stage). Empty string if none.

environmentAnchorY.description: y coordinate (in the environment viewBox) of the horizontal line in your environment that must sit on the physical reference line: the support line if bodies hang from supports, otherwise the ground / lowest track surface. -1 if nothing in the environment needs alignment.

surface.description: Seamless horizontally tileable SVG strip of what bodies move or rest on; its top edge is the contact line. Empty string if no surface applies.

support.description: SVG of the fixed fixture a connector is attached to; its bottom-centre is the attachment point and the kit turns that edge towards the body. Empty string if unused.

connector.description: SVG of the connector (string, rod, cord, spring, chain...) drawn along +x; the kit stretches its length between support and body; its viewBox height is the thickness in pixels (1.5-30). Empty string if unused.

svg.description: Complete standalone SVG document of the body only (no connectors, supports, labels or vectors), drawn facing +x, tightly framed, rich but compact.

facing.description: Which way the drawing faces; the kit mirrors it when the body moves the other way. none = symmetric.

rotate.description: velocity: nose follows the direction of motion; link: hangs along its connector; none: stays upright.

anchor.description: bottom = rests on its surface; center = the solver point is the body's centre; auto = kit default.

sizeMeters.description: Real-world size of the body's largest dimension in metres (0 = let the kit choose a readable size).

instruments.description: One instrument per state quantity to show (temperature, current, voltage, charge, pressure, nuclei count, coil angle …) and, with drive.property 'none', a static picture of a participant that does not move. You draw the static body and, separately, the moving part; you declare how the solver field moves the part. The kit applies that mapping every frame, adds scale marks and prints the verified value.

field.description: Exact solver field key '<participantId>.<quantity>' that drives the part.

label.description: Short caption in the user's language ('' = the quantity name).

svg.description: Complete SVG of the static body only (case, dial face, tube, lamp housing, circuit…): nothing that should move or change, no numbers.

part.description: Complete SVG of the moving part only (needle, liquid column at FULL level, glow, electron, piston, coil…), drawn in the SAME viewBox coordinate system as svg so it sits in place. '' when drive.property is 'none'.

drive.description: Mapping from the field to the part. The field's scale runs from min to max (null = the kit uses the solver range); its low end gives 'from', its high end gives 'to', linearly in between. All points in the body's viewBox units.

property.description: rotate: part turns about pivot, from/to = angles in degrees clockwise from the drawing (a needle, a lever); translate: part slides along path, from/to = fractions 0…1 of the path (piston, pointer); reveal: part is shown from path[0] towards the last path point up to fraction from/to (liquid column, bar, charge level); scale: part scales about pivot by factor from/to (balloon); opacity: part alpha from/to (glow, brightness); travel: 'copies' copies of part (drawn at path[0]) circulate along path at a speed proportional to the field, 'to' = laps over the run at the peak value (charges in a wire; close the path by repeating the first point for a loop); none: static picture.

path.description: Points for translate / reveal / travel (at least 2); [] otherwise.

useFieldAngle.description: rotate only: turn by the field's own angle (the field is an angle, e.g. a rotating coil) instead of from/to.

min.description: Low end of the field scale in its unit, or null for the solver range.

max.description: High end of the field scale in its unit, or null for the solver range.

links.description: Straight solver-bound connections redrawn every frame: a rope over a pulley, a wire from a charge to a probe, a rod between two bodies. Empty if none.

from.description: A moving participant id, or a fixed world point 'x,y' in metres.

to.description: A moving participant id, or a fixed world point 'x,y' in metres.

links.description: Draw a plain line for a declared connector when no connector artwork is given.

angles.description: Angle marks for bodies on connectors.

scene.description: The stage the kit assembles and keeps bound to the verified solver data: environment and surface art (static), one SVG body per moving participant (moved by the kit), instruments for state quantities (driven by the kit) and links. Every changing visual must come from here or from the kit calls in code.

code.description: Optional PixiJS v8 program async function(PIXI, app, api) { const base = await api.kit.illustratedScene(api.sceneSpec); … return { update(frame) { base.update(frame); … }, resize() { base.resize(); }, setData() { base.setData(); } } } that extends the kit stage with static props, base.follow / base.link / base.instrument / base.attach. Empty string when the scene alone is enough (preferred).
